theme.archetype: 3 (Pastel & Soft) & 1 (Organic & Earthy) Hybrid - The Editorial Notebook Variant
theme.description: A Google Search reimagined as a luxury Pinterest-inspired editorial scrapbook. It balances the structural familiarity of a search engine with the tactile, chaotic beauty of a physical moodboard. It uses soft pastels, organic textures, and cinematic typography.

background.description: Ivory/Cream - The main canvas, resembles fresh high-quality paper.

background_alt.description: Warm Beige - Used for cards, search bar backgrounds, and subtle section dividers.

text.description: Deep Charcoal - High contrast for readability without the harshness of pure black.

text_secondary.description: Warm Gray - For metadata, timestamps, URLs, and subtitles.

typography.primary_font_role: Body text, UI elements, search results, tabs, standard readability (Sans-Serif).
typography.secondary_font_role: Cinematic headings, project titles, editorial pull quotes (Serif).
typography.accent_font_role: Handwritten annotations, signature, arrows, doodles, 'People Also Ask' margin notes.

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-serif tracking-tight leading-none text-[#2D2A26]
hierarchy.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-serif tracking-tight leading-tight text-[#2D2A26]
hierarchy.h3: text-xl sm:text-2xl font-sans font-medium tracking-tight text-[#2D2A26]

spacing_and_layout.grid_system: CSS Grid, breaking conventional rows. Use overlaps and negative margins.
spacing_and_layout.masonry: Use CSS columns or an irregular grid layout (e.g., column-count-1 md:column-count-2 lg:column-count-3 gap-6) for the Projects Pinterest section.
spacing_and_layout.border_radius: rounded-none or rounded-sm (retaining a print/paper feel rather than bubbly app UI)

search_hero.layout: Centered vertically and horizontally, heavy top padding (pt-32).
search_hero.search_bar: Max-width 3xl, pure white background, subtle border (border-[#E8E4DB]), large padding (py-4 px-6), rounded-full to mimic Google. Drop shadow glowing with dusty pink.
search_hero.tabs_nav: Flex wrap, centered, below search bar. Links styled as simple text with underline on active state, using Outfit font, text-sm.
search_hero.ai_suggestion: A small floating card below the search bar, styled with a soft lavender border and a sparkle icon, reading 'AI Overview: Anita is an elite engineer...'

pinterest_masonry_card.image: w-full object-cover grayscale-0 transition-all duration-500 hover:scale-105
pinterest_masonry_card.wrapper: overflow-hidden border border-[#E8E4DB] bg-[#F9F7F3] p-3 shadow-sm group
pinterest_masonry_card.decorations: Absolute positioned 'tape' (a translucent div bg-white/60 w-12 h-4 -rotate-45 -top-2 -left-2 shadow-sm) or 'paperclip' SVG.
pinterest_masonry_card.content: Hover overlay or placed below image. Title in Cormorant Garamond, tags in uppercase tracking-widest text-[10px].

google_result_card.layout: Flex column, mimicking a search result. URL breadcrumb on top, clickable blue/charcoal Title, short snippet description below.
google_result_card.typography: URL: text-sm text-[#A3B19B]. Title: text-xl font-medium text-[#2D2A26] hover:underline. Snippet: text-base text-[#6B6661].

internet_traces_table.layout: A minimalist, stripped-back HTML table mimicking browser history. border-b border-[#E8E4DB] for rows.
internet_traces_table.columns: Timestamp (text-xs text-[#8A7986]), Page Title (text-sm font-medium), URL (text-sm text-[#A3B19B])

people_also_ask.layout: Accordion style (use Shadcn Accordion heavily customized).
people_also_ask.styling: No background, border-y border-[#E8E4DB]. Trigger is text-lg font-serif.
people_also_ask.decorations: Add absolute positioned handwritten notes (Caveat font) near the accordion arrows.

textures_and_decorations.background_texture: A fixed overlay with pointer-events-none. Use a subtle noise SVG pattern (opacity-30) and a mix-blend-multiply crumpled paper texture image.
textures_and_decorations.floating_elements: Scatter small SVGs or images (botanicals, stars, scribbles) using absolute positioning and high z-index, fading in on scroll.
textures_and_decorations.dividers: Instead of solid lines, use SVG squiggly lines or dotted borders.

motion_and_interactions.scrolling: Lenis smooth scroll is MANDATORY for the premium cinematic feel.
motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Images scale up slightly. Text links get a delicate underline offset-4. Buttons shift background color slightly.
motion_and_interactions.page_load: Staggered fade-up for search bar, tabs, and results.
motion_and_interactions.accessibility: Respect prefers-reduced-motion. Ensure focus states have a visible ring in #D1BFAe.

paper_texture.description: High-res crumpled white paper texture. Use as a fixed, low-opacity, mix-blend-multiply background overlay.

botanical_accent_1.description: Delicate watercolor roses. Use absolutely positioned, scaled down, with mix-blend-multiply as decorative corner accents.

botanical_accent_2.description: Vintage botanical illustrations overhead. Crop or mask specific areas to use as collage elements.

project_placeholder_1.description: Aesthetic neutral architecture/workspace. Placeholder for project images until real ones are provided.

profile_placeholder.description: Retro still life. Use as a moodboard/profile placeholder image in the 'About Me' section.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install `lenis` for smooth scrolling (crucial for editorial feel).
Set up Tailwind colors exactly as defined in this JSON.

Construct the Hero section to mimic a literal Google Search interface but themed with pastel luxury. Include the search bar, 'Search', 'I'm Feeling Lucky' (themed buttons), and a row of tabs (All, AI Mode, Images, etc.).
For the Projects page, use a Masonry layout. You can use CSS columns (`columns-1 sm:columns-2 lg:columns-3 gap-6`) or a library like `react-masonry-css`.
Implement the 'People Also Ask' section using Shadcn Accordion, styling it minimally to look like Google's version but with serif fonts.
Layer the background paper texture heavily. Create a global div with fixed positioning, full screen, z-index -1, containing the `paper_texture` URL with `opacity-20` and `mix-blend-multiply`.
Use raw HTML/Tailwind for artistic overlays (masking tape made of rotated white divs with opacity, scribbles as absolute text overlays).
